title: SCA targets.json (K2)
description: The target set of one scan run: written by an adapter or by the optional `sca targets --source github` resolver, read by osv, merge and the scan matrix. Unknown keys are allowed (additive evolution).

host.description: Additive. Host of the repo, e.g. github.com.

event.description: Raw platform event name (schedule, workflow_dispatch). Written by the resolver, copied into report.json when present.

trigger.description: Additive. Neutral form of event (K1 SCA_RUN_TRIGGER).

scan_ref.description: Only for a run focused on one tag.

forced_image_scan.description: Only when a manual run forced the OSV image scan on a repo that switched it off.

version_kinds.description: Optional, caller-added. Ref (as given in a target) to version kind, for refs that are not semver tags.

acceptances.description: Optional, caller-added risk acceptance rules (engine README, Acceptance rules). Other keys are passed through.

target.description: A Trivy target, or its OSV twin (same id, scanner osv; every Trivy target has one, listed after all Trivy targets).

id.description: Names the subject, stable across runs, never contains the SHA. Unique per (scanner, id).

status.description: pending = to be scanned; the others are resolved already.

tag.description: Image tag, or the release tag of a release source.

ref.description: Full image reference (kind image), else null.

git_ref.description: Branch or tag of a source target (kind fs).

image_scan_disabled.description: OSV twin of an image: the direct OSV image scan is off, the BOM query stays.
